section.4: The Book On The Mosques And The Congregations

4.name_native: The Book On The Mosques And The Congregations

hadiths.text: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Mughaffal Al-Muzani said:"The Prophet said: 'Perform prayer in the sheep's resting-places and do not perform prayer in the camels' resting-places, for they were created from the devils
